question: What do we use to sing a sweet melody? 🎤
explanation: Awesome! We use our voice and mouth to sing beautiful songs and melodies together! 🗣️
hint: You also use it to talk to your friends.

question: How do we make a fun rhythm using our two hands? 👏
explanation: Great job! We hit our hands together to clap and make a steady beat! 👏
hint: We do this when we applaud a good show.

question: Which wooden instrument do we play by blowing air into it? 🌬️
explanation: Super! A flute is a lovely wind instrument that makes music when we blow into it. 🪈
hint: It is a long, thin stick with holes.

question: What is the traditional Indian name for a flute made of bamboo? 🎋
explanation: Fantastic! The Bansuri is a beautiful bamboo flute played in Indian music. 🪈
hint: It starts with the letter B.

question: How can we make a strong beat using our shoes on the floor? 👞
explanation: Brilliant! Tapping our feet on the ground makes a great thumping rhythm! 🦶
hint: You use your legs to do this.

question: Which round instrument do we beat with our hands to make a loud sound? 🥁
explanation: Awesome! A Dholak is a popular Indian drum that we play with both hands! 🥁
hint: It is used a lot in folk songs and weddings.

question: When we sing a very happy song, what do our faces usually do? 😄
explanation: Great job! Happy music makes us feel joyful, so we naturally smile while singing! 😊
hint: It shows your teeth and means you are glad.

question: Songs that our grandparents sing about our village and traditions are called... 🏡
explanation: Super! Folk songs are traditional songs that people sing together in their communities. 🎶
hint: They tell stories of our culture.

question: What is the best thing to do when you hear a fast, energetic music beat? 🎵
explanation: Fantastic! Fast music makes our bodies want to get up and dance to the rhythm! 💃
hint: It means moving your body to the music.

question: Which sweet animal is famous for singing beautiful melodies early in the morning? 🌅
explanation: Brilliant! Birds sing lovely chirping songs to welcome the new day! 🐦
hint: It has feathers and flies in the sky.

question: In the game 'Musical Chairs', what must we listen to while walking around the chairs? 🪑
explanation: Awesome! We listen closely to the music, and when it stops, we must quickly sit down! 🎵
hint: It is playing from the speaker.

question: What do we hold in our hand to make our singing voice sound much louder? 🎤
explanation: Great job! A microphone makes our voice loud so a big crowd can hear us sing! 🎙️
hint: Singers use this on a big stage.

question: When many children stand together and sing the same song, it is called a... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Super! A choir is a wonderful group of people singing in harmony together! 🎼

question: Which cool instrument has strings that we pluck with our fingers? 🎸
explanation: Fantastic! We strum and pluck the strings on a guitar to make awesome music! 🎸

question: In a musical game, what tells us it is time to freeze or stop moving? 🛑
explanation: Brilliant! When the music suddenly stops, that is our cue to freeze like a statue! 🔇

question: How does a soft, slow lullaby song usually make a baby feel? 🍼
explanation: Awesome! Lullabies are gentle songs that help babies relax and fall fast asleep. 😴

question: What small metal bells do Indian dancers tie around their ankles to make a jingling sound? 💃
explanation: Great job! Ghungroos jingle beautifully to the rhythm when dancers tap their feet! 🔔

question: What loud sound does a big temple bell make when we ring it? 🛕
explanation: Super! A big bell makes a loud and clear 'Ding Dong' ringing sound! 🔔

question: Which important body part helps us listen to the beautiful music? 👂
explanation: Fantastic! Our ears catch the sounds of the rhythm and melody so we can enjoy the music! 👂
hint: They are on the sides of your head.

question: When we step left and right nicely to a drum beat, we march like a... 🪖
explanation: Brilliant! Soldiers march neatly in a line following the strong beat of a drum! 💂
hint: They wear uniforms and protect the country.

question: When you hit a drum, what kind of sound does it give us? 🥁
explanation: Awesome! Hitting a drum makes a loud, strong beat that helps everyone keep time! 💥

question: What happens when we hear a very silly and funny song? 😂
explanation: Great job! Funny songs are meant to bring us joy and make us laugh out loud! 🤣

question: Which large instrument has black and white keys that we press with our fingers? 🎹
explanation: Super! The piano makes beautiful music when we press its black and white keys! 🎹
hint: It has many keys like a computer board.

question: How do we play a tambourine to make its little metal discs jingle? 🪇
explanation: Fantastic! We hold a tambourine and shake it to the beat to make a fun, jingling sound! 🪇
hint: Move it side to side fast.

question: What do we call a talented person who sings songs for others to hear? 🎤
explanation: Brilliant! A singer uses their lovely voice to share music and melodies with the world! 👩‍🎤

question: What musical sound do heavy rain drops make when they fall on the roof? 🌧️
explanation: Awesome! The rain falling creates a natural 'pitter-patter' rhythm that sounds like soft drums! 💧

question: When we play the game 'Pass the Parcel', what tells us to pass the box quickly? 🎁
explanation: Great job! While the music is happily playing, we must pass the parcel to our friend! 🎶

question: What special thing in music tells the dancers whether to move fast or slow? 💃
explanation: Super! The rhythm is the beat of the music. Dancers follow the rhythm to move perfectly! 🎵

question: Which of these is a shiny brass instrument that we blow into? 🎷
explanation: Fantastic! A trumpet is a loud brass instrument that plays bright and happy notes! 🎺

question: What do we naturally do with our head when we enjoy a very good song? 🎵
explanation: Brilliant! Nodding our head is a simple way our body feels and shows the beat of the music! 😌

question: What amazing 'natural instrument' do we all carry inside us every day? 🗣️
explanation: Awesome! Our voice is the most special instrument because everyone has their own unique sound! 🗣️

question: Folk songs are very special because they tell musical stories about our... 🌾
explanation: Great job! Folk songs keep our culture alive by singing about village life and old stories. 🏡

question: What action do we do to a drum with our hands or sticks to make a sound? 🥁
explanation: Super! We tap or hit the top of the drum to make the air vibrate and create a beat! 💥

question: Which wooden string instrument is played using a long, thin stick called a bow? 🎻
explanation: Fantastic! We slide the bow across the violin's strings to make smooth and sweet music. 🎻
hint: You rest it on your shoulder to play.

question: When a song sounds like a bunny running very fast, the rhythm is... 🐇
explanation: Brilliant! Fast and quick rhythms give the music lots of exciting energy! ⚡

question: What small object do a sports coach and a traffic police officer blow to make a loud beep? 😗
explanation: Awesome! A whistle makes a very sharp, loud sound when you blow hard into it! 🪈
hint: You put it in your lips and blow.

question: What musical sound do we make when we sing a tune with our lips closed? 🎶
explanation: Great job! Humming is singing a sweet melody without opening your mouth to say the words. 🎵

question: In a marching parade, what big instrument keeps everyone walking together at the same time? 🥁
explanation: Super! The big drum's loud boom helps all the marchers step their feet together! 🥁

question: A soft and sweet 'Lullaby' song is usually sung to a... 👶
explanation: Fantastic! Mothers and fathers sing gentle lullabies to help little babies fall asleep. 🍼

question: What is a popular musical game where children hold hands, walk in a circle, and fall down? ⭕
explanation: Brilliant! Ringa Ringa Roses is a fun song where we dance in a circle and then all fall down together! 🌹

question: What do we call the written words of a song that we sing? 📝
explanation: Awesome! Lyrics are the beautiful words that match the melody to make a complete song! 📜

question: When we rub our thumb and middle finger together quickly, we make a... 🫰
explanation: Great job! Snapping our fingers makes a cool clicking sound that we can use to keep a beat! 🎶

question: Which of these makes a soft, tinkling musical sound when the wind blows? ✨
explanation: Super! Wind chimes hang outside and play pretty tunes when the breeze moves them! 🎐

question: To sing or speak very, very softly is to... 🤫
explanation: Fantastic! Whispering is using a quiet voice so only the person very close to you can hear. 🤫

question: When the loud school bell rings in the morning, what does the sound tell us? 🔔
explanation: Brilliant! The school bell is a helpful sound that tells us it is time to line up and learn! 🏫

question: What special song do we sing together when a friend cuts their cake? 🎂
explanation: Awesome! We sing the 'Happy Birthday' song to celebrate our friend's special day! 🎈

question: The main tune of a song that we easily remember and hum is called the... 🎼
explanation: Great job! The melody is the beautiful line of musical notes that makes a song special. 🎵

question: If we want to listen to our own singing later, what device can we use to record it? 📱
explanation: Super! A phone or tape recorder can save our voice so we can hear our nice singing again! 📲
hint: It has a screen and apps.

question: Which of these is a beautiful, traditional Indian string instrument? 🪕
explanation: Fantastic! The Sitar is a famous classical Indian instrument with many strings to pluck! 🪕
hint: It sounds a little like a guitar.

question: Singing, dancing, and playing music with our lovely friends makes us feel... 🥰
explanation: Brilliant! Music brings people together and spreads lots of joy and happiness! 😊
hint: You smile when you feel this.
